Another narration states that Hadhrat Ummu Is'haaq (RA) said, "I said, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I keep weeping about the murder of (my brother) Is'haaq.' Rasulullaah ﷺ then took a handful of water and sprinkled it on my face." Hadhrat Ummu Hakeem says, "Even when enormous tragedies struck Ummu Is'haaq (RA), you would see tears well up in her eyes, but they never flowed on to her cheeks."[^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports, "Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) once instructed us to ride with him to the countryside where his tribe resided. We then left and Ubay bin Ka'b (RA) and I were behind the others. When a cloud started to thunder (and rain started to pour), Ubay (RA) made du'aa saying, 'O Allaah! Avert its harm from us.' When we caught up with the rest, their carriages were soaking wet (while we were dry). Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, 'Did the rain that fell on us not fall on you?' I replied, 'Abu Mundhir (Ubay (RA)) prayed to Allaah to avert the harm of it from us.' 'Why did you not pray for us as well?' Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked."[^3]
A Branch is Turned into a Sword

Hadhrat Zaid bin Aslam (RA) and others have narrated that when Hadhrat Ukaasha bin Mihsin (RA)'s sword broke during the Battle of Badr, Rasulullaah ﷺ gave him a branch, which transformed into a sturdy and sparkling sword while in his hand.[^4]

Hadhrat Khaythama reports that a man once came to Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) with a casket of wine. Hadhrat Khaalid (RA) made du'aa saying, "O Allaah! Transform it into honey." The wine then turned into honey.

Another narration states that when a man passed by Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) with a casket of wine, Hadhrat Khaalid (RA) asked him what it was. When the man (lied and) said that it was vinegar, Hadhrat Khaalid (RA) said, "May Allaah make it vinegar." When the people then looked at it, they found that it was vinegar even though it had been wine.[^5]

Yet another narration states that when a man passed by Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) with a casket of wine, Hadhrat Khaalid (RA) asked him what it was.
